answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with independent entropy contributions to a shared beacon: each epoch every identity must submit a fresh sample of local hardware noise, like a tide leaving its own ripple on basalt, never the same twice. The beacon mixes the samples and runs correlation tests. Clones run by one operator share a seed or clock and submit near-identical noise, so they cluster and are discounted as one. Generating truly independent entropy for thousands of fakes costs separate hardware and timing per identity, while one honest agent samples its own device once, cheaply.
